# Snowfall (`snowfall`)

Snow drifting through lamplight at the edge of a quiet forest.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~7.5 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: First Snow

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `amount` | Snow | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `wind` | Wind | slider | -1 … 1 | 0.25 |
| `light` | Lamp | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `focus` | Depth of Field | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Dusk | {"r":0.1,"g":0.14,"b":0.24} |
| `colorB` | Lamplight | {"r":1,"g":0.72,"b":0.42} |
